description: Main application source file for Bluetooth peripheral using Zephyr RTOS, handling connection, security, and advertising.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth connection event, sets security, and logs connection status.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Handles Bluetooth disconnection event and logs reason.

methods.name: identity_resolved
methods.description: Handles identity resolution event and logs RPA to identity mapping.

methods.name: security_changed
methods.description: Handles security level change and logs status.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, initializes Bluetooth, registers callbacks, and starts advertising.
